newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms after heavy buying before T-bill sale.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms after heavy buying before T-bill sale.

text.p: The rouble firmed on Thursday, reflecting a shortage of funds after heavy buying by non-residents this week before the Treasury bill auctions that helped it recover from early lows, dealers said.
rouble/dollar Feb 13 midday Feb 13 early Feb 12 close
"There is a serious demand for the rouble as banks are in a hurry to invest in T-bills," Bank Vozrozhdeniye chief dealer Maxim Poltavets said.
He said non-residents had sold a lot of dollars in the run-up to Wednesday's T-bill auctions.

Dealers said Wednesday's comments by Central Bank First Deputy Chairman Sergei Aleksashenko that the central bank had enough reserves to support the rouble in its corridor had not affected the market.
Dealers said they had never doubted the central bank was strong enough to fulfill its policies and hold the rouble within the corridor.
